title: SEM Analysis Detail
description: Dataset-level analysis-instance detail for SEM (superset), reusing CDIF/schema.org slots on the schema:Dataset root.

anyOf.title: 3D Image Registration
anyOf.description: Method used to align consecutive SEM image slices in the 3D stack to correct for drift, vibration, and curtaining artifacts. Include software used.

anyOf.title: Segmentation Method
anyOf.description: Method and software used to separate distinct phases or features in the reconstructed 3D volume, turning the grayscale volume into labelled regions.

anyOf.title: Beam Damage Minimization
anyOf.description: Describes any measures taken to reduce electron beam damage to the sample during analysis. Examples: reduced accelerating voltage, lowered beam current, defocused or rastered beam, cooled stage, short acquisition sequences, or rotating between multiple points.

anyOf.title: Beam Raster Dimensions
anyOf.description: Dimensions of the small area over which the beam is rastered at a single analysis point, reported as width × height in µm. Applicable when Beam Mode = Rastered; defines the effective spatial footprint of the measurement. Not applicable when mapping.

anyOf.title: Chamber Pressure
anyOf.description: Chamber pressure and gas type during analysis. Required for variable pressure (VP-SEM) and environmental SEM (ESEM) modes. Report value and unit (Pa or Torr) and gas composition. Use 'None' for standard high-vacuum operation.

anyOf.title: CL Integration Time
anyOf.description: Acquisition time per pixel (hyperspectral map mode) or per spectrum (spectral point mode), in ms or s.

anyOf.title: CL Wavelength Calibration Reference
anyOf.description: Reference light source or standard material used to calibrate the wavelength axis of the CL spectrometer. Required for quantitative spectral CL and hyperspectral mapping.

anyOf.title: Drift Correction
anyOf.description: Describes whether and how stage or beam drift was monitored and corrected during the measurement session. Examples: periodic stage realignment to a fiducial marker, automated beam drift correction in acquisition software, or reanalysis of a reference point at regular intervals.

anyOf.title: EBSD Frame Time
anyOf.description: Acquisition time per EBSD diffraction pattern frame in milliseconds.

anyOf.title: EBSD Phase List
anyOf.description: Mineral phases included in the EBSD reference pattern library for this procedure. Phases may be added for specific sample compositions beyond the expected suite for the target material.

anyOf.title: EBSD Step Size
anyOf.description: Distance between adjacent EBSD measurement points in the map in nm or µm. Must be smaller than the smallest grain of interest.

anyOf.title: EDS Live Time per Point or Pixel
anyOf.description: EDS spectral acquisition live time per analysis point or per pixel in seconds.

schema:name.const: EDS Live Time per Point or Pixel

anyOf.title: Halogen Correction on Oxygen
anyOf.description: Whether oxygen content was adjusted to account for halogen substitution (F and/or Cl replacing OH) in halogen-bearing phases such as apatite, amphibole, and mica, where oxygen is calculated by stoichiometry.

anyOf.title: Image Pixel Size
anyOf.description: Physical size of each image pixel at the sample surface, in nm or µm. For large-area mosaic imaging, report the pixel size of individual tiles and the number and arrangement of tiles.

anyOf.title: Step Size / Pixel Size
anyOf.description: Centre-to-centre distance between adjacent measurement points (WDS mapping) or pixels (EDS mapping) in µm.

anyOf.title: Working Distance
anyOf.description: Distance between the objective lens pole piece and the specimen surface in millimetres.

anyOf.title: Coarse Milling Conditions
anyOf.description: Ion beam voltage and current used for bulk material removal during FIB milling. For TEM specimen preparation: bulk trenching to isolate the lamella and intermediate thinning. For 3D tomography: face preparation and initial slice removal.

anyOf.title: Fine Polishing Conditions
anyOf.description: Ion beam voltage and current for final thinning and surface polishing of the TEM lamella.

anyOf.title: Protective Coating Deposition
anyOf.description: Type and deposition conditions of the protective coating applied to the sample surface before FIB milling. E-beam deposition should be applied as the initial layer. Typical coatings: platinum (Pt) or carbon (C). State material, deposition method, beam conditions, and approximate thickness.

schema:description.description: Ion beam voltage and current used to mill each slice during FIB-SEM serial sectioning.

ada:edsDeadTime.description: Percent dead time reported by the EDS detector during the session — the fraction of total acquisition time the detector spent processing rather than counting. This field documents the resulting percentage as a session QC metric. Unlike WDS dead time (see WDS Dead Time Correction), no user-selectable correction algorithm is required.

anyOf.title: Foil Thickness
anyOf.description: Target thickness of the electron-transparent TEM lamella after final FIB polishing, in nanometres. Actual thickness may differ from target.

anyOf.title: Slice Thickness
anyOf.description: Thickness of each FIB-milled slice during serial sectioning in nanometres.

contains.title: Foil Thickness
contains.description: Target thickness of the electron-transparent TEM lamella after final FIB polishing, in nanometres. Actual thickness may differ from target.

contains.title: Slice Thickness
contains.description: Thickness of each FIB-milled slice during serial sectioning in nanometres.

ada:proceduralBlankLevel.description: The measured level of the analytical blank in the session, and — where the reported quantity is a ratio — its composition, since a blank subtracted from a ratio biases the result unless its own composition is known. Companion to the blank correction method.

dqv:value.description: Fraction of EBSD map points successfully indexed, expressed as a percentage of total map points.
Mean angular deviation (MAD) of the EBSD pattern indexing solution in degrees. MAD quantifies the misfit between experimental Kikuchi band positions and the best-fit crystal orientation.
Minimum pattern quality or confidence index threshold applied during EBSD data processing to exclude unreliably indexed points from orientation maps. Include metric name and threshold value.

ada:mapDimensions.description: Number of pixels in the EDS map in the X and Y directions. Based on the area of interest and selected pixel size.

items.title: Map Area
items.description: Physical extent of the mapped region, given either as width × height in µm or as a total area in µm² or mm², and equal to (map width in pixels × step size) × (map height in pixels × step size). Complements the map's pixel-grid dimensions by recording the physical scale of the mapped region.

contains.title: Map Area
contains.description: Physical extent of the mapped region, given either as width × height in µm or as a total area in µm² or mm², and equal to (map width in pixels × step size) × (map height in pixels × step size). Complements the map's pixel-grid dimensions by recording the physical scale of the mapped region.

ada:voxelSize.description: X, Y, Z dimensions of the reconstructed 3D voxel in nanometres (X-Y pixel size from SEM image calibration; Z from slice thickness), and the total number of slices in the stack.

ada:imageStackDimenstions.description: X, Y, Z dimensions of the reconstructed 3D voxel in nanometres (X-Y pixel size from SEM image calibration; Z from slice thickness), and the total number of slices in the stack.
